description: Plannotator for Qwen Code. The PermissionRequest hook on exit_plan_mode opens the plan review UI: a deny returns the feedback to the model right away, while an approve is confirmed once more in the terminal, because Qwen Code always shows its own plan confirmation for exit_plan_mode and ignores a hook allow there. Note: a PreToolUse hook does NOT fire on exit_plan_mode in Qwen Code (verified 2026-10-08), so it cannot be used to hold the model's turn. The PreToolUse hook on enter_plan_mode injects the Plannotator Flavored Markdown reminder when the pfmReminder setting is enabled (silent passthrough otherwise).
